blocks.text: Liquid ke molecules ke darmiyan bain-al-molecular (intermolecular) quwwatein khasi mazboot hain. Yahan teen qismein bayan hain: instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces), permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces, aur hydrogen bonding.

blocks.alt: Baen: do electron badal jin ke lamhati musbat aur manfi sire ek doosre ko khinchte hain, halogens, noble gases aur alkanes ke boiling points ki fehristein, aur pentane ke teen isomers ke lakeeri khaake. Darmiyan: teen HCl molecules musbat se manfi ki tarteeb mein, aur teen pani ke molecules nuqtedar hydrogen bonds se jure. Daen: ammonia aur hydrogen fluoride par notes, HF ki tehri-merhi zanjeer, aur fi molecule hydrogen bonds ginne ka dabba.
blocks.caption: London forces, dipole-dipole forces aur hydrogen bonding (Figures 5.2 se 5.5 aur Tables 5.1 aur 5.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek electron badal ki lamhati na-hamwari parosi mein dipole paida karti hai, jo London force deti hai jo sab molecules ke darmiyan kaam karti hai aur non-polar maddon mein wahid force hai; yeh molecular mass aur surface area ke saath barhti hai, to boiling points F2 se I2, He se Xe, methane se decane, aur sukre neopentane se seedhe n-pentane tak barhte hain. HCl aur chloroform jaise polar molecules musbat sire se manfi sire ki tarteeb mein bhi lagte hain. Jab hydrogen lone pair wale F, O ya N se bandhi ho to sab se mazboot intermolecular force, hydrogen bond, banta hai: pani ke har molecule mein do, ammonia mein ek (ek lone pair) aur HF mein ek (ek hydrogen).

blocks.prompt: Is topic ki teen intermolecular forces ke naam batayein aur kahein ke in mein se kaun si argon, HCl aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan kaam karti hain.
blocks.explanation: Forces London (instantaneous dipole-induced dipole) forces, permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces aur hydrogen bonding hain. Argon atoms mein sirf London forces hain. HCl molecules mein London forces ke saath dipole-dipole forces hain. Pani ke molecules mein dono ke ilawa hydrogen bonds hain.

items: Liquids mein teen intermolecular forces: instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London), permanent dipole-permanent dipole, aur hydrogen bonding.
